nodes.doc:
**IMO 2024, Problem 1.** A real number `α` has the property that, for every positive
integer `n`, the integer `⌊α⌋ + ⌊2α⌋ + ⋯ + ⌊nα⌋` is a multiple of `n`, if and only if `α` is
an even integer.

hypotheses.name: h
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (n : Nat), LT.lt 0 n → Dvd.dvd (↑n) ((Finset.Icc 1 n).sum fun i => Int.floor (HMul.hMul (↑i) β))

∀ (β : Real) (m : Int) (n : Nat),
  Eq ((Finset.Icc 1 n).sum fun i => Int.floor (HMul.hMul (↑i) (HAdd.hAdd β (HMul.hMul 2 ↑m))))
    (HAdd.hAdd ((Finset.Icc 1 n).sum fun i => Int.floor (HMul.hMul (↑i) β))
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul m ↑n) (HAdd.hAdd (↑n) 1)))
